programme.desc: 'S3/E15 - Fire Brigade On Foot / The Prettiest Pebble In The'. The Firemen Smurfs lose their truck after arguing over who should drive, while Gargamel's enchanted rocks captivate Lily and the village.

programme.title: Judge Judy
programme.desc: 'S23/E229 - Teen Stupidity Causes Bodily Injury!/The Bee's Kne'. An unlicensed teen causes a serious crash, former roommates dispute money. Meanwhile, an illegal eviction and a ridiculous counterclaim come into play.

programme.title: Divorce Court
programme.desc: 'S24/E42 - Run Me My Coins: Elizabeth Glass V Dontavious Well'. Divorce Court features stories from couples filing for divorce and need a judge to mediate their disputes.

programme.title: Ouma Sarie

programme.title: Yosef

programme.title: e.tv News

programme.title: eGagasini - Waves Of Change
programme.desc: 'S1/E104'. Sihle lies to deflect Senzo's suspicion, humiliating Rebecca. The Khumalos pray for Kenneth as Lwandle battles guilt. Njabulo uncovers Sihle's betrayal but is silenced by a threat.

programme.title: Land Of Mills And Money
programme.desc: 'S1/E59 - The Price Of Betrayal'. Phiwe finds out Nkosi is dead. She is compelled to tell Muzi the truth and make amends with him. Thami and Lihle must deal with threats and demands from Fubu.

programme.title: The Four Of Us
programme.desc: 'S1/E104'. Kat and Balungile take major steps toward their future, while Papi and Vera reach breaking point and a hat thief is identified.

programme.title: Isitha - The Enemy

programme.title: Emzini: A Family Legacy
programme.desc: 'S1/E159'. Rorisang wants to return Panyaza's money, while Junior grows closer to Chester. Mmaphefo and Marinade face heartbreak, and Shaka is warned of a dangerous enemy.

programme.title: Durban Gen
programme.desc: 'S1/E90'. Sbusiso involves Mbali is his plans to redecorate the commune and she is not interested and Phumeza is struggling to come to terms with her decisions. MacGyver is back to being jolly after he escapes from the police.

programme.title: Imbewu: The Seed
programme.desc: 'S1/E90'. Phakade warns Khanyo, the period of grace will be a testing time. When Zithulele demands to see Macingwane. Phakade scrambles, paying the Sangoma to leave.

programme.title: Broken Vows

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
